state.question: Has Elm Accelerators's operating change resolved the question about HBM allocation? Focus on: The September confirmed HBM allocation as a share of the memory required for the announced target.
state.conclusion: Elm announced a larger accelerator production target.
state.gap: The September confirmed HBM allocation as a share of the memory required for the announced target.

candidates.title: Elm Accelerators: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Elm Accelerators, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of the September confirmed HBM allocation as a share of the memory required for the announced target.

candidates.title: Elm Accelerators: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Elm Accelerators's strategy in HBM allocation, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Elm Accelerators: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Lina Ortiz's Dispatch's dispatch on Elm Accelerators, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Elm Accelerators: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Elm Accelerators's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.

candidates.title: Elm Accelerators: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Elm Accelerators features in a field guide to HBM allocation. The worked example draws on a separate setting: a conference schedule includes sessions titled HBM allocation and memory markets.

candidates.title: Elm Accelerators: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: Elm signed memory allocation schedule supports a dated assessment of the September confirmed HBM allocation as a share of the memory required for the announced target.
